newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK 1996 GRAIN HARVEST FALLS TO 3.32 MLN TONNES.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK 1996 GRAIN HARVEST FALLS TO 3.32 MLN TONNES.

text.p: Slovakia's 1996 grain harvest fell to 3.32 million tonnes from 3.49 million tonnes in 1995, the Ministry of Agriculture said on Tuesday.

Vladislav Peniasko of the ministry's plant production department told Reuters the wheat harvest fell to 1.71 million tonnes from 1.94 million tonnes in the previous year. The barley crop totalled 0.72 million tonnes, compared with 0.79 million tonnes in 1995.

"Slovakia's annual consumption is expected to be at about three million tonnes of grain this year, of which 0.7-1.0 million tonnes should be used for human consumption and about two million tonnes for fodder," Peniasko said.
He did not disclose further details, and could not comment on possible imports of grain.
